dialogues.speaker: Reko
dialogues.text: That's not the sort of question one asks around here. Things come from where they come from — that's all you need to know. That said...

dialogues.speaker: Reko
dialogues.text: Have you ever heard of the Atlas? It sank years ago near the Eye of Kratti. Well, even after all this time, there are still treasures down there on the ocean floor.

dialogues.speaker: Reko
dialogues.text: Legends say that one of those treasures is the Proof of the Cognoscenti, left behind by the legendary thief, Reed Miller.
